Record Stock Event.description: Records a stock receipt, issue or adjustment at a facility using product and facility codes.

Initiate Requisition.description: Starts a new requisition for a facility and program in the suggested period.

Submit Requisition.description: Submits a previously initiated requisition for approval.

Approve Requisition.description: Approves a submitted or authorized requisition.

Create Facility.description: Registers a new health facility in reference data.

Get Stock On Hand.description: Gets stock card summaries (stock on hand per product and lot) for a facility and program.

Search Requisitions.description: Finds requisitions for a facility and program, optionally by status and date range.

Get Requisition.description: Gets one requisition with its line items by id.
Get Requisition.code:
// Fetch a single requisition and its line items.
get(`/requisitions/${$.data.requisitionId}`);

List Facilities.description: Lists facilities, filtered by name, code or geographic zone.

List Products.description: Lists orderable products, optionally filtered by code, name or program.

List Orders.description: Lists fulfillment orders from a supplying facility, filtered by status.

List Proofs Of Delivery.description: Lists proofs of delivery for a given order.
